import sys,json,argparse,subprocess,os
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'artifacts/webtransport';sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'scripts'))
import inspection
original=subprocess.Popen;client=[None];roles={}
def popen(cmd,*a,**kw):
 if cmd[0]=='perf':
  cmd=list(cmd);index=cmd.index('-p');roles['server']=int(cmd[index+1]);roles['client']=client[0]
  assert roles['client'];cmd[index+1]+=','+str(roles['client']);cmd[cmd.index('-e')+1]='cycles';cmd[cmd.index('-F')+1]='249';cmd+=['-m','512'];cmd=['sudo','-n']+cmd
 p=original(cmd,*a,**kw)
 if any(Path(str(x)).name=='inspection' for x in cmd):client[0]=p.pid
 return p
subprocess.Popen=popen
for v in ['quic-recordless','ack-eight']:
 client[0]=None;roles.clear()
 source=out/'thin-pending-final-mixed.json';a=json.loads(source.read_text())['args'];a.update(server=str(out/f'binaries/{v}-relay'),profile=True,seconds=8,output=str(out/f'ack-eight-reliable-mixed-{v}-profile.json'))
 for k in ['server','client','client_source_root','tls_front','tls_cert','tls_key','tls_ca','heap_profile','heap_library','output','fanout_latency_output']:
  if a.get(k) is not None:a[k]=Path(a[k])
 r=inspection.run(argparse.Namespace(**a));assert r['passed'];data=a['output'].with_suffix('.perf.data')
 for role,pid in roles.items():
  text=subprocess.run(['sudo','-n','perf','report','--stdio','--no-children','-g','none','--pid',str(pid),'--sort','dso,symbol','--percentage','relative','--percent-limit','0.3','-i',str(data)],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout
  assert 'Total Lost Samples: 0' in text
  (out/f'ack-eight-reliable-{v}-{role}-symbols.txt').write_text(text)
 (out/f'ack-eight-reliable-{v}-profile-roles.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(roles),indent=2))
 subprocess.run(['sudo','-n','chown',f'{os.getuid()}:{os.getgid()}',str(data)],check=True)
 print('DONE',v,roles,flush=True)

limits: Three runs per workload/build; variation substantial. Do not infer confidence intervals from median deltas.
100000-session ordinary RSS/CPU is one matched pair.
Per-connection Quinn I/O counters are not kernel syscall counts; ACK frame/datagram ratios are not CPU shares.
Protocol gates include a small post-measurement ACK tail. A request counter proves transmission; reduction in received ACKs supports peer response.
Loss/reorder fixture cases are single samples, not statistical rankings or identical packet trajectories.

Memory and full native WebSocket throughput parity remain unachieved; no push, deployment or PR.
